title: The studio as a mixed, friendly hangout
summary: Musicians could hang out and bring girlfriends in the studio, eat at black restaurants like Lovata's, and interracial relationships were accepted among friends.

story.theme_name: Race and segregation in the jazz life
story.community_name: Segregation on the road and the bandstand
